image_description: A cooked Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) resting on a white plate. The crab exhibits the characteristic broad, oval carapace with reddish-orange coloration typical of cooked crustaceans. The ventral side is visible, showing folded abdominal flaps and walking legs tucked underneath. One large cheliped (claw) is prominent, while other legs are partially obscured or folded. The background includes a glass and blurred restaurant setting elements.

The legs on the right side appear to merge slightly with the plate and each other, lacking clear separation at the distal ends.
The rim of the glass in the background shows slight warping inconsistent with rigid geometry.
